title: Kaho Naa... Pyaar Hai
emojiPlot: a young man dreams of being a singer
he falls for a rich girl
he sees a murder and is killed
funFact: It was Hrithik Roshan's first lead role and Ameesha Patel's first film, and it made Hrithik a star overnight.

title: Hera Pheri
emojiPlot: three broke men share one shabby house
they plan to grab the ransom money
funFact: It is a remake of the Malayalam comedy 'Ramji Rao Speaking', and its landlord Baburao later became a meme legend.

title: Lagaan
altTitles: Lagaan: Once Upon a Time in India
emojiPlot: but the British still demand tax
a British officer offers a bet
win a cricket match and pay no tax
so farmers learn cricket from scratch
funFact: It was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film.

title: Dil Chahta Hai
emojiPlot: they take a famous trip to Goa
one, a painter, loves an older woman
a fight splits the friends apart
until life brings them back together
funFact: Farhan Akhtar's debut as a director changed how Hindi films showed young city friendships.

title: Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham...
emojiPlot: the adopted son marries for love
his strict father throws him out
he starts a new life in London
his little brother sets out to reunite them
funFact: Its giant cast put Amitabh and Jaya Bachchan, Shah Rukh Khan, Kajol, Hrithik Roshan and Kareena Kapoor into one family drama.

title: Gadar: Ek Prem Katha
emojiPlot: the riots and trains of Partition
saves and marries a girl from the other side
her family takes her away to Pakistan
so he crosses the border to bring her home
funFact: It opened on the very same day as Lagaan, and both became huge hits.

title: Devdas
emojiPlot: are kept apart by family pride
the heartbroken hero turns to drink
while his first love keeps a lamp burning
funFact: Based on Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay's classic novel, it was screened at the Cannes Film Festival.

title: Munna Bhai M.B.B.S.
emojiPlot: joins medical college to please his father
he treats patients his own way
with warm hugs instead of rules
funFact: It was Rajkumar Hirani's first film as director and was later remade in Tamil and Telugu.

title: Koi... Mil Gaya
emojiPlot: a gentle young man with a childlike mind
a friendly alien is left behind
and it gets its powers from sunlight
funFact: Rakesh Roshan directed his son Hrithik, and the film launched the Krrish superhero series.

title: Kal Ho Naa Ho
emojiPlot: the serious daughter falls for him
so he helps her marry her best friend
funFact: It was Nikkhil Advani's first film as director, written and produced by Karan Johar.

title: Main Hoon Na
emojiPlot: goes undercover as a college student
funFact: Choreographer Farah Khan made her debut as a director with this film.

title: Dhoom
emojiPlot: teams up with a bike-mad mechanic
funFact: It kicked off the Dhoom series, which grew to three films with a new villain each time.

title: Bunty Aur Babli
emojiPlot: they become con artists in disguise
while a tough cop chases them
funFact: In one of their boldest cons, the pair 'sell' the Taj Mahal to a foreign tourist.

title: Rang De Basanti
emojiPlot: a British woman makes a film
their pilot friend dies in a jet crash
and turn into the rebels they played
funFact: Besides being India's official Oscar entry, it was nominated for a BAFTA award.

title: Don
emojiPlot: is replaced by a simple lookalike
the police plan to trap the gang
but nothing is what it seems
funFact: It remakes the 1978 Amitabh Bachchan film of the same name and was followed by Don 2 in 2011.

title: Chak De! India
emojiPlot: he unites them as one country
and they chase the world cup
funFact: Many of the women in the team were cast for their real hockey skills rather than their acting experience.

title: Taare Zameen Par
emojiPlot: a boy who loves to paint
an art teacher sees he has dyslexia
funFact: It was Aamir Khan's first film as director and helped start conversations in India about dyslexia.

title: Jab We Met
emojiPlot: meets a girl who never stops talking
she runs off to her boyfriend in the hills
funFact: Kareena Kapoor won the Filmfare Best Actress award for playing the chatty, carefree Geet.

title: Om Shanti Om
emojiPlot: he dies in a studio fire
and is reborn as a superstar
to take revenge thirty years later
funFact: It was Deepika Padukone's first Hindi film, and about thirty stars appear together in one of its songs.

title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa
emojiPlot: a couple moves into an old palace
the ghost of a dancer is behind it
funFact: It is a remake of the classic Malayalam film 'Manichitrathazhu'.

title: Welcome
emojiPlot: want a decent husband for their sister
they find a nice, honest boy
his uncle tries everything to stop the wedding
while one gangster paints terrible pictures
funFact: Anil Kapoor's gangster Majnu and his dreadful paintings became a favourite of meme makers years later.

title: Jodhaa Akbar
funFact: This grand historical epic runs for about three and a half hours, with music by A.R. Rahman.

title: Ghajini
emojiPlot: a man forgets everything every 15 minutes
and tattoos notes on his body
to find who killed his girlfriend
funFact: Director A.R. Murugadoss remade his own Tamil hit, and it is often called the first Hindi film to earn ₹100 crore in India.

title: Rab Ne Bana Di Jodi
emojiPlot: he invents a flashy new look to win her heart
they become partners in a dance contest
funFact: It was Anushka Sharma's first film.

title: 3 Idiots
emojiPlot: years later they search for their lost friend
funFact: It was loosely inspired by Chetan Bhagat's novel 'Five Point Someone'.

title: Dabangg
emojiPlot: with sunglasses tucked in his collar
clashes with his stepfather and brother
and takes on a local politician
funFact: It was Sonakshi Sinha's first film, and its swaggering cop Chulbul Pandey went on to lead a whole franchise.

title: Band Baaja Baaraat
emojiPlot: with one rule: no romance with partners
they break the rule and break up
but the weddings bring them back
funFact: It was Ranveer Singh's first film and director Maneesh Sharma's debut.

title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
emojiPlot: three old friends on a road trip
each picks one scary adventure: diving
funFact: The friends' trip includes Spain's famous La Tomatina tomato-throwing festival.

title: Delhi Belly
emojiPlot: three roommates in a messy flat
one gets a terrible stomach bug
one is full of smuggled diamonds
now a gangster wants them back
funFact: Produced by Aamir Khan, it was made mostly in English, which was rare for a big Bollywood release.

title: Gangs of Wasseypur
emojiPlot: a feud starts with a grandfather
funFact: The story was so long that it was released in two parts, and both were shown at Cannes.

title: Kahaani
emojiPlot: to search for her missing husband
funFact: Many street scenes were filmed among real Durga Puja crowds in Kolkata.

title: Vicky Donor
emojiPlot: and picks a jobless Delhi boy
but he keeps it secret from his wife
funFact: It was Ayushmann Khurrana's first film, and he also sang one of its most popular songs.

title: Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani
emojiPlot: with an old school friend who loves travel
he leaves to see the world
they meet again at a wedding years later
funFact: It was one of the biggest hits of 2013, and its mountain trek inspired many real trips to Manali.

title: Chennai Express
emojiPlot: a man must take his grandfather's ashes south
her father is a powerful village don
funFact: Its 'Lungi Dance' song was a tribute to superstar Rajinikanth.

title: Bhaag Milkha Bhaag
emojiPlot: a boy loses his family in Partition
and discovers he can run very fast
funFact: The real Milkha Singh is said to have sold the rights to his story for just one rupee.

title: Queen
emojiPlot: is dumped a day before her wedding
she goes on the honeymoon alone
funFact: Kangana Ranaut won the National Award for Best Actress for playing the jilted bride.

title: PK
emojiPlot: his remote to go home is stolen
everyone says only God can help
so he asks awkward questions about religion
song: Love Is a Waste of Time
funFact: Aamir Khan reportedly tried not to blink on camera, so his alien would look strange to humans.

title: Bajrangi Bhaijaan
emojiPlot: a little girl who cannot speak
he takes her home to Pakistan
funFact: Its story came from K. V. Vijayendra Prasad, the writer behind the Baahubali films.

title: Piku
emojiPlot: they road-trip from Delhi to Kolkata
with a fed-up taxi company owner
funFact: Amitabh Bachchan won the National Award for Best Actor for playing the grumpy father.

title: Dum Laga Ke Haisha
emojiPlot: is pushed into an arranged marriage
he is unhappy with his wife
until a race where husbands carry their wives
funFact: It was Bhumi Pednekar's first film, and she gained weight specially for the role.

title: Dangal
emojiPlot: cuts their hair and makes them run at dawn
funFact: Based on wrestler Mahavir Singh Phogat and his daughters, it also became a massive hit in China.

title: Hindi Medium
emojiPlot: wants his daughter in a top school
so the family pretends to be poor
funFact: This comedy pokes fun at how desperately city parents chase admission to English-medium schools.

title: Stree
emojiPlot: a female ghost visits during a festival
and takes away men at night
people write a warning on their walls
a scared gang of friends sets out to stop her
funFact: It was inspired by the 'Nale Ba' urban legend from Karnataka and started a whole horror-comedy universe.

title: Andhadhun
funFact: It was inspired by the French short film 'L'Accordeur' (The Piano Tuner), and Ayushmann Khurrana won a National Award for it.

title: Gully Boy
funFact: It was inspired by Mumbai street rappers such as Divine and Naezy, and it became India's Oscar entry.

title: Uri: The Surgical Strike
emojiPlot: after an attack on an army camp
his commandos cross the border at night
funFact: It was Aditya Dhar's first film as director, and Vicky Kaushal won a National Award for it.

title: Chhichhore
emojiPlot: a teenager is in hospital after failing an exam
his father tells him a story
about his own college hostel days
who fought hard in a sports championship
funFact: It won the National Award for Best Hindi Film.

title: Tanhaji: The Unsung Warrior
emojiPlot: his army climbs the cliff with a lizard's help
funFact: It was Ajay Devgn's 100th film.

title: Shershaah
emojiPlot: promises to marry his college love
funFact: It tells the story of Captain Vikram Batra, who received the Param Vir Chakra for his bravery in the Kargil War.

title: Gangubai Kathiawadi
emojiPlot: a girl dreams of becoming an actress
is betrayed and sold in Mumbai
she rises to rule her neighbourhood
and fights for the rights of its women
funFact: Alia Bhatt won the National Award for Best Actress for the title role.

title: Brahmastra Part One: Shiva
emojiPlot: a secret society guards magical weapons
and the most powerful one must be protected
funFact: It is planned as the first part of a trilogy in a shared world its makers call the Astraverse.

title: Pathaan
emojiPlot: who plans a deadly virus attack
funFact: It marked Shah Rukh Khan's return as a leading man after more than four years and is part of the YRF Spy Universe.

title: Jawan
emojiPlot: a masked man hijacks a metro train
to force the rich to help the poor
a father and son both fight the system
with a message about voting wisely
funFact: It was the first Hindi film for both director Atlee and actress Nayanthara.

title: 12th Fail
emojiPlot: fails and restarts again and again
until he becomes a police officer
funFact: It is based on the real life of IPS officer Manoj Kumar Sharma, who cleared the civil services exam after many setbacks.

title: Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani
altTitles: Rocky Aur Rani Ki Prem Kahani
emojiPlot: falls for a smart Bengali TV journalist
they each move in with the other's family
to win over very different households
funFact: It was Karan Johar's return to directing a feature film after a gap of seven years.

title: Animal
emojiPlot: a son desperate for his father's love
someone tries to kill his father
he goes on a violent revenge spree
funFact: At about three hours and twenty minutes, it is one of the longest Hindi blockbusters in years.

title: Stree 2
emojiPlot: the old gang teams up again
with the mysterious woman from before
funFact: Part of a shared horror-comedy universe, it became one of the highest-grossing Hindi films ever.

title: Laapataa Ladies
emojiPlot: two new brides with veils over their faces
the groom takes home the wrong bride
a hunt for the missing wife begins
funFact: Directed by Kiran Rao and produced by Aamir Khan, it was chosen as India's official Oscar entry.

title: Chhaava
emojiPlot: the 'lion cub' son of a great king
funFact: Vicky Kaushal plays Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj, Shivaji Maharaj's son; 'chhaava' means lion cub in Marathi.

title: Saiyaara
emojiPlot: her words make his music a hit
then she starts losing her memory
funFact: It was the first film for both of its lead actors and became a surprise blockbuster.
